programme.officialTitle: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS)
programme.medium: English and Chinese; Chinese may be used in clinical learning and assessment depending on the internship organisation.
programme.summary: MUST offers an approved six-year MBBS: five years of coursework and clinical attachments followed by a supervised 12-month internship. Students Traffic can assess eligibility, build a component-by-component cost plan and prepare an official-portal application.

mandatoryKnownCharges: student health-care insurance, health examination, textbooks and dormitory charged separately where applicable
fee.notes: The first-year figure is not a six-year total. Sixth-year internship tuition varies by country and hospital; MUST says tuition may increase by about 5% each year.

admissions.overview: Direct Admission is open to Form 6 or equivalent applicants through MUST's Online Application System. MBBS has higher programme-specific thresholds and a Faculty of Medicine interview.
verifiedRoutes: A Level/IAL: two A grades or three B grades plus two AS subjects, including B or above in Chemistry
IBDP: diploma, overall 36 or above and Higher Level Chemistry grade 4 or above
Canadian Grade 12: overall and Chemistry 80% or above
steps: Upload qualification and identity documents required for the applicable route
Wait for Faculty of Medicine notification if qualified for interview
Complete offer confirmation, payment and registration steps
admissions.cycleNote: For 2026, direct applications ran 22 January-22 April, qualified MBBS applicants were interviewed in May, and classes commenced 1 September.

programme.academics: The curriculum uses a year-based structure. Year 3 includes hospital, family-medicine and community-health rotations. The final year comprises four supervised three-month rotations at recognised local or overseas training units; MUST monitors clinical experience and supervisor logbooks.
programme.recognition: Macao's Education and Youth Development Bureau lists MUST MBBS as an approved bachelor programme. HKCAAVQ reviewed the programme in 2025 under Macao's higher-education quality-evaluation system. These facts do not create automatic professional registration outside the jurisdiction where a graduate seeks to practise.
programme.accommodationSupport: Non-local first- and second-year undergraduates are required to live in MUST dormitories, and non-local third-year undergraduates are guaranteed placement. MUST publishes Student Affairs contacts for dormitory, counselling, scholarships, student visa and group insurance; the live dormitory fee table must be used for the selected room type.
programme.scholarships: MUST lists competitive international admission scholarships for outstanding applicants. Distinguished awards cover tuition and accommodation with a living allowance; full and half awards cover tuition. Scholarship retention depends on published academic-performance thresholds.
faqs: English and Chinese are listed. Chinese may be used in clinical teaching and assessment according to the internship organisation.
HKD 258,000 is the 2026/27 first-year non-Macao-resident tuition. The sixth-year internship charge varies by country and hospital.
Year 3 includes clinical foundation rotations. The final year is four supervised three-month rotations at recognised training units.
Is the degree approved in Macao?
DSEDJ lists MUST MBBS as an approved bachelor programme. Registration requirements depend on the place of future practice.
Yes, through OAS if they meet one of the published qualification routes. MBBS candidates also complete a Faculty interview when invited.
MUST lists distinguished, full and half international admission scholarships for selected high-performing applicants.
Can I use a recruitment agent?
No. MUST states it has not authorised agents and directs applicants to its official Online Application System.
MUST requires residence for non-local first and second years and guarantees third-year undergraduate placement; price depends on the current room table.
